_about: Default settings shipped with Da BT Dynamic Lock. Your own settings live in %APPDATA%\Da BT Dynamic Lock\config.json. Restart the app after editing.
_target: How to recognise the phone: part of the name it broadcasts, or a MAC address. Empty = pick it in the app.
_silence_s: Seconds without a signal before locking. Measured: a phone in a pocket plus a Bluetooth mouse leaves gaps up to 20 s, so anything below ~30 s causes false locks.
_active: Master switch. Can also be toggled from the icon near the clock.
_countdown: Small countdown window before locking. Information only - it cannot cancel the lock.
_countdown_from_s: How many seconds before locking the countdown appears.
_countdown_vertical: Vertical position of the countdown window. 0.33 = one third from the top, 0.5 = middle of the screen. Horizontally it is always centred.
_rssi_threshold: Range (sensitivity). null = off, only a complete loss of signal counts. A number (e.g. -86) means a weaker signal no longer counts as 'at the desk', so it locks sooner. Measured: -81 dBm at the desk, -83 dBm three metres away.
_threshold_window_s: Over how many seconds the signal strength is smoothed (median). Shorter = faster reaction, more noise.
_idle_guard: Do not lock while the keyboard or mouse is in use. CAREFUL: anyone at the desk can postpone locking this way.
_idle_guard_s: How long the user must be idle before that guard stops blocking.
_scanner_restart_s: How often to restart the Bluetooth scanner as a precaution. A long-running scanner in Windows gradually goes deaf.
_silence_watchdog_s: After this much silence, restart the scanner - the phone may be fine and the receiver stuck.
_alert_no_signal_min: After how many minutes without a signal to warn that watching has stopped working. 0 = never warn.
_language: Interface language: 'cs' or 'en'. Can also be switched in the app.
_log: Write events to dyn_lock.log in the data folder.
